panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Reality splinters here. The chamber exists in multiple states simultaneously — walls that are also sky, floors that are also ceilings. At the nexus of this impossibility, the Shattered Oracle coalesces from broken light and prophecy.

panels.speaker: Shattered Oracle
panels.text: You arrive as foreseen. All paths converge here. I have seen your victory. I have seen your defeat. Both are... inevitable.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Oracle's fragments realign, the impossible geometry settling into something that merely aches to look at rather than wounds. The prismatic distortion fades, revealing a crystal chamber of startling beauty.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: A vision crystal lies among the shards — one of the Oracle's eyes, still warm with fading sight. Within it, you glimpse images: a throne of bone, a king who should not be, and behind it all... a presence watching. Waiting.

panels.speaker: Shattered Oracle
panels.text: This outcome was also foreseen. Your fragments scatter across the possible. Perhaps in another timeline, you persist.
